title: Two more ways to play with AI
summary:
Two community projects joined the showcase while image requests gained more selective prompt handling and a cache for repeat URLs.

The creative apps list added @mangofoxplay’s Roblox game Watch TV with neko, where players can chat with AI characters or each other, and @andreas_11’s PixPax, which can analyze, remix, and create images through chat.

Image requests from configured referrer domains now take a separate path that turns prompts into semantic opposites. The image queue limit dropped from 10 to 8 jobs; text model defaults and availability also changed, including the removal of Claude 3.5 Haiku from the model list.

A Cloudflare Worker was added to cache image responses by URL path and normalized query parameters, so matching requests can reuse a result. Cache misses go to the image origin; requests outside `/prompt` and those marked `no-cache` bypass the cache.
